messages:
maria: Heads up — we need a plan for region cordoning behavior when a region is legally or operationally cordoned. Today the proxy sometimes just redirects and we end up with ambiguous KV ownership.

aj: Is the trigger legal requests or outages, or both?

maria: Both. Example flows: an EU residency takedown request, or a large networking outage. We need a 'cordon' mode that: 1) prevents new writes in the cordoned region for tenants that require residency, 2) keeps existing in-flight sessions alive where possible, 3) drains or hands off KV cache ownership without split-brain.

sam: Noted. Our current sticky session affinity is proxy-side cookie + control-plane lease. When we cordon we expire the lease and proxies start failing requests; that's not graceful.

ellie: Proposal idea: control-plane emits a cordon signal to dataplane nodes. Nodes enter READ-ONLY + HANDOFF state and advertise a small handoff window. Add a header so proxies can make deterministic decisions: "X-Region-Cordon: true" and "X-Cordon-Until: <ts>".

chen: Quick sketch for proxy behavior (pseudo):

```
# on request arrival
if tenant.requires_residency && node.region == tenant.region && node.cordoned:
  if within_handoff_window:
    # allow reads, forward writes to fallback with escrow id
    forward_to(fallback_region, add_header("X-Escrow-Write", id))
  else:
    return 409 "region cordoned"
else:
  route_normally()
```

sam: KV cache handoff is the hard part. We need a lease handshake + snapshot of hot prefixes or a way to mark prefixes escrowed so fallback can warm safely. Otherwise we risk orphaned hot prefixes and double-writes.

aj: For routing we should add two new headers the proxy and clients can use: "X-Prefer-Region" (soft hint) and "X-Residency-Required" (strict). Control-plane routing table will be consulted and will honor tenancy overrides: some tenants can be allowed to keep writing during cordon.

ellie: The escrow-write idea makes sense: writes accepted by fallback until the cordoned node finishes replay. That implies idempotency keys and write-replay logs. We'll need to ensure replay doesn't violate ordering for strong-residency tenants.

maria: Operational plan (proposal):
1) small refactor: proxy routing interface to evaluate cordon headers + tenant stamps (1 week) — owner: aj
2) control-plane cordon API + UI + telemetry (1 week) — owner: ellie
3) KV lease handshake spike + escrow-write prototype (2 weeks) — owner: sam
4) header semantics + small proxy tests (3 days) — owner: chen
Owners: aj, ellie, sam, chen; I'll oversee.

ops-bot: incident-bot: added runbook note "region cordon - operator steps" to /runbooks/region-cordon.

chen: I'll prototype header semantics and unit tests this week and open a PR with a tiny mock of the control-plane signal.

sam: I can do a 3-day spike on lease transfer mechanics this sprint. Will report back with a sequence diagram.

ellie: Add telemetry events: cordon_start, cordon_grace_end, lease_transfer_start, lease_transfer_success, cordon_clear. That will let us measure how often handoffs complete.

aj: +1 :thumbsup:

maria: Great. Follow-up sync tomorrow 09:00 to align circuit-breakers and canaries. Please bring any blocking constraints (legal, k8s scheduling, HSM/KMS) to that meeting. :calendar:
